privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Owe Yeah keeps track of what a group of people spends together and works out who owes whom. This notice says what personal data it processes, why, for how long, and what your rights are. This is a test environment: don't enter anything sensitive.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.who: The controller of your personal data is {name} ({business}), NIP {nip}.
controller.contact: Write to {email} about anything in this notice. No data protection officer has been appointed.

data.title: What is processed
data.intro: There are no accounts: Owe Yeah never asks for your email address, phone number or a password. It processes:
data.trips: Trips: their name and Trip currency, the names of their Participants, their Expenses and Repayments (titles, amounts, dates and times, who paid and how each one is split), and every Revision of each Expense.
data.device: A random id each device makes up for itself, and which Participant you say you are on it. Both are sent with every change you make, so the Trip shows who changed what.
data.notifications: If you turn Notifications on: your browser's push subscription (its address at your browser's push service and the keys that encrypt messages for it), and which Participant you are.
data.reminders: When one Participant last sent a Reminder to another.
data.ip: Your IP address, which every request to the server carries.
data.none: There is no analytics, advertising or profiling, and no decision about you is made automatically.

namedByOthers.title: If someone else added you to a Trip
namedByOthers.body: Participants are usually added by someone else in the Trip, and may never open the app. Then your name, and the Expenses and Repayments you take part in, come from the other Participants of that Trip. We know nothing else about you and have no way to reach you, so this public notice is how we inform you (Art. 14(5)(b) GDPR).

purposes.title: Why, and on what legal basis
purposes.sync: To store Trips and sync them between the devices of the people who share them, work out balances, and send the Notifications and Reminders they ask for. The legal basis is legitimate interests (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR): the Participants' interest in keeping one shared record of what they spent, and ours in providing it.
purposes.security: To keep the service secure and available: the server limits how many requests one IP address can send, and Cloudflare protects it from attacks. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in the security of the service (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR).
purposes.voluntary: Entering data is voluntary, but without names and Expenses there is nothing to share.

recipients.title: Who else sees it
recipients.tripLink: Everyone who has a Trip's Trip link can see and change everything in that Trip. Share it only with the people in the Trip.
recipients.cloudflare: Cloudflare, Inc. passes every request on to the server, so it sees your IP address and what the app sends, Trip contents included. It acts as our processor under its {dpa}. Where Cloudflare transfers data to the United States, it relies on the EU–US Data Privacy Framework, with the standard contractual clauses as a fallback.
recipients.push: If you turn Notifications on, they are delivered by the push service your browser uses (for example Google for Chrome, Mozilla for Firefox, Apple for Safari, Microsoft for Edge), which your browser picks, not us. Messages are encrypted for your browser: the push service sees where and when one goes, not what it says. It may be outside the European Economic Area.
recipients.server: We run the server ourselves, in the European Union, with no hosting company involved. The server fetches exchange rates from a public rate service, sending it only currencies and dates.

retention.title: How long it is kept
retention.test: This is a test environment: its data may be wiped at any time without notice, and the whole test database is wiped at least once every 12 months. Until then, Trips are kept with every Revision.
retention.backups: Before each update of the app, the server copies its database. The last 5 copies are kept, and data erased from the database stays in them until newer copies replace them.
retention.notifications: A push subscription is deleted when you turn Notifications off, forget the Trip, or the push service says it no longer exists.
retention.ip: The server keeps IP addresses for limiting requests only in memory, for a few minutes. Cloudflare keeps its logs as its own policies set.
retention.device: On your device, a Trip stays until you forget it, clear the site's data or uninstall the app.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.list: You have the right to access your data and get a copy of it, to have it rectified or erased, to restrict its processing, to object to it (Art. 21 GDPR), and to data portability.
rights.how: There are no accounts, so we find a Trip only by its Trip link. Write to {email}, send the Trip link and say what you want: holding the link shows you may ask about that Trip. We answer within a month.
rights.noLink: If you were added to a Trip but don't have its link, ask someone in the Trip for it: without it, we may not be able to find your data (Art. 11 GDPR).
rights.inApp: You can change and delete Expenses in the app yourself, but every Revision is kept: to erase it, write to us.
rights.complaint: You can complain to the President of the Personal Data Protection Office (Prezes Urzędu Ochrony Danych Osobowych, ul. Stawki 2, 00-193 Warszawa, {uodo}), or to the data protection authority where you live or work.

storage.title: What the app keeps on your device
storage.intro: Owe Yeah sets no cookies and uses no analytics. It keeps on your device only what it needs to work, so it doesn't ask for consent:
storage.indexedDb: IndexedDB: the Trips on this device with their Trip links, which Participant you are in each, changes not synced yet, and exchange rates, so the app works offline.
storage.localStorage: Local storage: this device's random id; light or dark mode, if you pick one; that you dismissed the suggestion to install the app; and whether this server is a test environment.
storage.serviceWorker: A service worker and its cache: the app's own files, so it opens offline, and the code that shows Notifications.
storage.remove: Forget a Trip in its Trip tab to remove it from this device. To remove everything, clear this site's data in your browser's settings, or uninstall the app.

changes.body: If this notice changes, the new version is published here with its date.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms set the rules for using Owe Yeah at this address, a service provided by electronic means. Read them before you create or join a Trip. This is a test environment: don't enter anything sensitive.

provider.title: Who provides the service
provider.who: Owe Yeah is provided by {name} ({business}), a sole trader entered in the Polish Central Register and Information on Economic Activity (CEIDG), NIP {nip}.
provider.register: The full entry, address included, is public in the CEIDG company search at {ceidg}: search by the NIP.
provider.contact: Write to {email} about anything in these terms.

service.title: The service
service.intro: Owe Yeah keeps track of what a group of people spends together and works out who owes whom. It lets you:
service.trips: create Trips, add their Participants, and record Expenses and Repayments, in the Trip currency or any other;
service.share: share a Trip by its Trip link, and sync it between the devices of everyone who has the link;
service.balances: see everyone's balance, and the Suggested Repayments that even them out;
service.notifications: get Notifications about other Participants' changes, and send Reminders;
service.offline: use it offline, and install it as an app.
service.free: The service is free. There are no accounts: whoever has a Trip link can see and change everything in that Trip.

requirements.title: Technical requirements
requirements.intro: To use Owe Yeah, you need:
requirements.browser: a current version of a web browser such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari, with JavaScript on and site data allowed;
requirements.connection: an internet connection to open it the first time and to sync; after that, it works offline too;
requirements.notifications: for Notifications, a browser that supports web push; on iPhone and iPad, the app added to the Home Screen.
requirements.cookies: Owe Yeah sets no cookies. What it keeps on your device is described in the {privacy}.

agreement.title: Starting and ending the agreement
agreement.start: The agreement to provide the service is concluded, for an indefinite period, when you first create a Trip or open a Trip link.
agreement.endYou: You can end it at any time, without giving a reason, by no longer using Owe Yeah and forgetting your Trips on your device. How to have your data removed from the server is described in the {privacy}.
agreement.endUs: As this is a test environment, we may stop providing the service at any time; when we can, we say so in the app beforehand. We may also block access to a Trip whose content breaks the law or these terms (see below).

content.title: Content rules
content.intro: You are responsible for what you enter into Owe Yeah. Don't enter or share through it:
content.unlawful: content that is illegal, or that infringes other people's rights, such as their personal rights or privacy;
content.offensive: insults, threats or hate speech, names and titles included;
content.sensitive: special categories of personal data (about health, beliefs, sex life and the like), or numbers of identity documents or payment cards;
content.misuse: anything that disrupts the service: don't try to break into it or overload it, or open Trips nobody gave you the Trip link to.
content.others: Add to a Trip only the people who take part in it.

moderation.title: How the rules are enforced
moderation.notMonitored: We don't read or monitor Trips, and no automated tools moderate them. We act on notices of illegal content (below), on orders of authorities, and on what we learn otherwise.
moderation.actions: If, after a person has reviewed it, we find that content is illegal or breaks these terms, we may delete it, or block access to the Trip it's in. We act diligently, objectively and in proportion, with due regard to the rights of everyone involved, freedom of expression included.
moderation.reasons: We have no way to reach the people in a Trip, so we can't tell them about a decision ourselves. Whoever writes to {email} with the Trip link gets the reasons for a decision about that Trip, and can contest it by a complaint (below) or in court.

report.title: Reporting illegal content
report.how: If you think something in Owe Yeah is illegal, report it to {email}. Your notice should hold:
report.reasons: a sufficiently substantiated explanation of why you think it is illegal;
report.location: exactly where it is: the Trip link, and which Expense, Repayment or Participant (its title or name, and date);
report.contact: your name and email address, unless the content concerns the sexual abuse or exploitation of children (Art. 3 to 7 of Directive 2011/93/EU);
report.goodFaith: a statement that you believe, in good faith, that the information and allegations in it are accurate and complete.
report.after: We confirm we've received your notice, review it without undue delay, and tell you our decision and how to contest it. No automated means process notices or decide on them.

contact.title: Points of contact
contact.authorities: Authorities of EU Member States, the European Commission and the European Board for Digital Services can contact us at {email}, our single point of contact under Art. 11 of the Digital Services Act (Regulation (EU) 2022/2065).
contact.users: Anyone who uses Owe Yeah can contact us at the same address, our single point of contact under Art. 12. A person reads and answers every message.
contact.languages: Write to us in English or Polish.

complaints.title: Complaints
complaints.how: If Owe Yeah doesn't work as these terms say, or you disagree with our decision about content, write to {email}. Say what happened and when, and what you ask for; if it's about a Trip, send its Trip link.
complaints.answer: We answer within 14 days, to the email address you wrote from.

test.title: A test environment
test.body: This instance of Owe Yeah is a test environment: its data may be wiped at any time without notice, and it may be unavailable, change or stop at any time. Don't rely on it as your only record of who owes whom.
test.liability: Owe Yeah is provided free of charge, as it is. We do our best to keep it working, but don't promise it will be available, or that its calculations will be free of errors. Nothing in these terms limits the rights a consumer has under mandatory law.

data.title: Personal data
data.body: How we process personal data is described in the {privacy}.

licenses.title: Software and licenses
licenses.body: Owe Yeah is open-source software under the MIT License. The licenses of the third-party software it includes are at {licenses}.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may change these terms for an important reason, such as a change in the law or in the service. The new version is published here with its date, at least 7 days before it takes effect, unless the law or security calls for a change sooner. If you don't accept it, stop using Owe Yeah.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: These terms are governed by Polish law. If you are a consumer, you keep the protection the mandatory law of the country you live in gives you.
